_readme: Curated, human-owned metadata for each recorded phase. Everything in tools/map/data/
is downloaded from Bay County and is regenerated on every run; THIS file is the part a
human maintains, and it is the file to edit when a phase sells out.
new-build    Minto still has homesites to sell here.
resale-only  no new-build homesites left; the only way in is a resale.
unconfirmed  renders with a hatched 'confirm' badge and is listed in the
'needs confirmation' block on the map. Use this rather than guessing.
confirmed:     set true ONLY once Karen has checked the phase against live inventory.
confirmed_on:  ISO date of that check.
karen_says:    first-person notes from Karen, who lives in Phase 8.
Proximity to Hwy 79, the Town Center and the Bandshell is NOT stored here - it is
measured from the recorded plat geometry at render time, so it can never drift.

map.data_credit: Phase boundaries & lots: Bay County, FL recorded plats (public record), plat book/page shown per phase
map.disclaimer: Illustrative only — not a survey. Phase availability changes; confirm current inventory before relying on it.
